title: Figure 9. Birmingham University HFGW Detector; Figure 10. INFN Genoa HFGW Detector
description: Two color laboratory photographs. Figure 9, "Birmingham University HFGW Detector", shows two rectangular loops of white tubing and optical components on lab tables with a laptop and equipment in the background. Figure 10, "INFN Genoa HFGW Detector", shows two polished metal spheres joined by a coupling, resting on plastic sheeting; the text describes them as coupled superconducting spherical harmonic oscillators.
